Merge pull request #26 from dsvleeuw/arena/2c692f38-vakman

Add GitHub commit history visualizer (Dutch, vanilla JS)

Add GitHub commit history visualizer (Dutch, vanilla JS)

Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS app in github-visualizer/ that visualizes a GitHub
repository's commit history from a static JSON export:

- index.html: Dutch UI, file upload / paste input, author and search
  filters, Bijdragen (heatmap) and Commits (timeline) views, dark mode toggle
- style.css: CSS custom properties theming, GitHub-style 52x7 calendar
  heatmap, timeline with vertical line, responsive layout, dark mode
- app.js: JSON parsing, heatmap aggregation, Dutch nl-NL date formatting,
  author/search filtering, SHA copy to clipboard, localStorage persistence
- commits.sample.json: small sample export for validation

Co-authored-by: arena-agent <297053741+arena-agent@users.noreply.github.com>

feat(seo): prerender every route, hydrate it, and finish the UX polish

SEO
- scripts/prerender.ts renders the homepage + all 35 presets through
  src/entry-server.tsx (renderToPipeableStream, waits for lazy chunks) and
  writes real HTML per route with title, description, canonical and
  Open Graph/Twitter tags, plus sitemap.xml, robots.txt and og-image.png.
- main.tsx hydrates prerendered markup instead of replacing it and preloads
  the matching route chunk; useMediaQuery starts from its fallback so the
  first client render matches.

UX
- Scroll offset is stored per history entry and restored on back/forward
  (new navigation still starts at the top).
- The mobile preview bar on a generated site collapses to one row with an
  'Aanpassen' toggle instead of wrapping to three rows.
- Images reserve space and pulse until loaded.
- Decorative hero photos are aria-hidden.

Co-authored-by: arena-agent <297053741+arena-agent@users.noreply.github.com>

feat(wizard): deliverable-first last step and a working quote channel

- Step 5 now opens with 'Je website staat klaar' and 'Bekijk je website' as
  the primary action (page + sticky bar); the appointment is a clearly
  labelled optional block below it.
- The WhatsApp/E-mail/Allebei choice finally does something: the confirmation
  renders a prefilled WhatsApp message and/or a mailto: with the appointment
  summary through buildQuoteRequestMessage/buildMailtoUrl.
- Google sign-in is opt-in via a checkbox; booking no longer opens a popup
  for visitors who did not ask for calendar sync.
- Platform contact details live in data/platform.ts.

Co-authored-by: arena-agent <297053741+arena-agent@users.noreply.github.com>

feat(analytics): vendor-free funnel events

utils/analytics.ts pushes GA4-shaped events to window.dataLayer/gtag when a
tag manager exists and does nothing otherwise, so the prototype stays
cookie-free but the funnel is measurable from day one.

Wired: page_view, wizard_step_view/complete, validation errors, preset_open,
plan_select, component_view, whatsapp_click, phone_click and
appointment_requested.

Co-authored-by: arena-agent <297053741+arena-agent@users.noreply.github.com>

feat(a11y): enforce WCAG AA on every generated palette

The five styles are generated from per-trade OKLCH inputs, so contrast was
never guaranteed: a vivid accent could produce white-on-yellow labels or grey
text on a tinted card.

- utils/color.ts: OKLCH <-> sRGB, WCAG contrast ratio and helpers that move
  only lightness until text passes (ensureContrast, ensureSurfaceContrast,
  bestOnColor).
- withAccessibleContrast() wraps computePalette so fg, muted, accentText and
  inverted text reach 4.5:1 on their real surfaces and onAccent/onHi stay
  readable on filled surfaces, keeping hue and chroma.
- data/paletteContrast.test.ts fails for any of the 7 trades x 5 styles.

product. This adds a small, dependency-free router on the History API and
routes every view, preset, wizard step and library item.

  title + description, legacy query redirects, unit tests.

  scroll restoration, hash targets; RouteLink renders a real <a href> and
  only intercepts plain clicks.

  /start/vak|stijl|gegevens|diensten|afspraak|klaar, /componenten/:id and a
  branded 404. public/_redirects keeps deep links working on Netlify.

Wizard
- Steps are controlled by the URL: browser back goes to the previous step.
- Step indicator is a nav with clickable completed steps, aria-current and
  "stap X van 5".
- Draft (sector, style, form, services) lives in App + sessionStorage, so
  opening the live preview and going back no longer loses input.
- Live preview is collapsed on phones instead of doubling page length.
- Form fields get labels, aria-invalid/describedby, role=alert,
  autocomplete and focus management.

UI/UX fixes

  use RouteLink ("Bekijk demo" / "Kies deze stijl").
- lang=nl, skip link, per-route titles, favicon, theme-color.
- Mobile menu closes on outside click and locks background scroll.
- Contact form labels, FAQ aria wiring and kicker typo, reduced-motion
  support, focus-visible rings, marquee duplicates hidden.
